<!-- Keep only the applicable prompts. Link existing evidence; short answers are enough.
Already-open PRs need only missing evidence. Corrections/cleanup do not need a new-project dossier. -->

## Change and evidence

Type: new project / existing-entry correction or cleanup / code or infrastructure

For new projects:

- Quant task, intended users and useful result:
- Representative implementation link; example/test link and expected behavior:
- One maintenance artifact; maintainer handle/team and public support route:
- License; external dependencies, credentials, access/payment restrictions; useful public workflow:
- Affiliation (or none); related entries and README/open/recently closed PR duplicate-search results:
- Checked evidence versus claims or unresolved questions:

Only for submitted hosted services without substantive public implementation (including thin
SDKs): permanent-free quant workflow; pricing and exact limits;
payment-information requirements; public documentation/methodology/example links:

For substantive source projects, disclose required hosted/data dependencies and their access
costs above. Paid dependencies alone do not impose the hosted-service free-tier eligibility rule.

For corrections/cleanup: existing entry, what is inaccurate/broken or being moved/removed,
and supporting evidence. For code/infrastructure: describe behavior changed and verification.

See [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/wilsonfreitas/awesome-quant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#evidence-to-include) for eligibility, historical/cleanup
exceptions and evidence guidance, and [review capacity](https://github.com/wilsonfreitas/awesome-quant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#review-capacity-and-outcomes)
for prioritization and the absence of a review SLA. Small, new, solo and pseudonymous projects
are welcome; paid hosting alone does not disqualify substantive public source.
